description: Sends one message, in the person's own words, into a conversation they already have with somebody they connected with at an event. Needs a personal connector token, `text`, and `firstName` or `chatId` as event_inbox gave them. It is delivered when the call returns and cannot be unsent. Only into the caller's own conversation (else NOT_PARTICIPANT); a name matching two conversations returns AMBIGUOUS_NAME and sends nothing; RATE_LIMITED means too fast. ok:true says nothing about a reply.

text.description: The message in the person's own words, up to 1000 characters. It is sent as given.

name: event_reply
title: Reply to a message
